June 1, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Nbt Bank N A decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 2.8% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Nbt Bank N A sold 3,340 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 115,885 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $19.44M, down from 119,225 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Nbt Bank N A who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $933.95B market cap company. The stock increased 1.68% or $3.145 during the last trading session, reaching $190.015. About 18.90M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
